notes: Weekly pocket money suggestions for the kids, and a tidier six-tab layout.

items: Every Friday at 5pm the adults get a suggested pocket money amount for each child for the week before: £4 an hour of jobs, minus 25p for every job sent back
Jobs in a child's own bedroom aren't paid
It comes to the adults' phones with Approve, Snooze (until 9am tomorrow) and Edit buttons, and shows in Needs you on Today with the full breakdown
When it's approved, the child gets a message on their phone saying how much they're getting
Jobs › Progress shows pocket money for past weeks
New add-on options: phones (who gets messages on which phone), pay_per_hour and pay_sent_back
Six tabs instead of eleven: Today, Calendar, Jobs, Shopping, Chat and Settings
Calendar holds Week, Schedule, Dinner and Nights in, and the week now shows dinners too. + Add on any day lets you add a chore, reminder, activity, night in, dinner or work shift
Jobs holds Rooms, Progress and Extra time
Settings has people and sign-ins, groups, suggested activities, nights in options, notifications and your account. Admins also find Logs (and System) there
Today opens on your own jobs, extra time requests wait in a Needs you box with a count on the Today tab, and a long late list for everyone folds away
The chores reminder banner only shows on Today
The shopping list now shows in Home Assistant (sensor.family_planner_shopping_list), so automations can send it to a phone, for example when someone gets to Basildon town centre
TiviSync's Today page shows how many jobs each person has left and roughly how long they should take, instead of the full list
Ticking off a job that belongs to someone else asks who did it, so the right person gets the credit and TV time
If you say you did someone else's job, they (or an adult) are asked to confirm before any TV time is added
The person whose job it was can answer on their phone or Family Planner; adults can also answer on the TV
Family Planner now runs inside Home Assistant, with its own tab in the sidebar and sign-in with your Home Assistant login
Chores you tick off add the same number of minutes to your TiviSync TV time for today
Extra jobs are checked by an adult (on their phone, TV or here) before they count, then they add TV time too
Jobs that are an hour late are read out on your speaker, and chores and today's reminders pop up on TiviSync
When an admin ticks off a job for everyone, it now only counts for the person it was for, so it stays on everyone else's list
Admins can see who still has to do a job for everyone
Cleaners can add an extra job they did that wasn't on their list
Clocking in and out has been removed
Admins are now told when a chore is marked as done
Cleaning hours are now estimated from the minutes on each chore
Rooms now show when each chore was last done and by who
Who is out tomorrow now replaces Working tomorrow and School tomorrow
